name: @agenttool/browser
description: Local-first browser control shaped for agents
author: AgentTool contributors

scripts.build: bun run clean && tsc && bun run build:mcp
scripts.smoke:runtimes: node --input-type=module --eval "const m = await import('./dist/src/index.js'); const p = await import('@agenttool/browser/protocol'); const u = await import('@agenttool/browser/understanding'); if (typeof m.AgentBrowser !== 'function' || typeof m.resolveBrowserCapabilities !== 'function' || typeof m.planBrowserAction !== 'function' || m.BROWSER_ACTION_RECEIPT_SCHEMA !== 'agent-browser-action-receipt/0.1' || p.BROWSER_OPERATIONS.length !== 9 || typeof u.createBrowserMaterial !== 'function' || u.BROWSER_UNDERSTANDING_SCHEMA !== 'agent-browser-understanding/0.1') process.exit(1)" && bun --eval "const m = await import('./dist/src/index.js'); const p = await import('@agenttool/browser/protocol'); const u = await import('@agenttool/browser/understanding'); if (typeof m.AgentBrowser !== 'function' || typeof m.resolveBrowserCapabilities !== 'function' || typeof m.planBrowserAction !== 'function' || m.BROWSER_ACTION_RECEIPT_SCHEMA !== 'agent-browser-action-receipt/0.1' || p.BROWSER_OPERATIONS.length !== 9 || typeof u.createBrowserMaterial !== 'function' || u.BROWSER_UNDERSTANDING_SCHEMA !== 'agent-browser-understanding/0.1') process.exit(1)"
scripts.ci: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test && bun run smoke:runtimes && bun run check:package
scripts.prepack: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
